description: This file defines a DispatchTableGL class that contains function pointers for various OpenGL functions, serving as a native binding interface for ANGLE's OpenGL backend. It is auto-generated and includes numerous OpenGL extension function pointers.

classes.name: rx::DispatchTableGL
classes.description: A class containing function pointers for OpenGL functions, used for dynamic loading of OpenGL API calls.

methods.name: loadProcAddress
methods.description: Pure virtual method to load function pointers by name.

methods.name: initProcsDesktopGL
methods.description: Initializes function pointers for desktop OpenGL based on version and extensions.

methods.name: initProcsGLES
methods.description: Initializes function pointers for OpenGL ES based on version and extensions.

methods.name: initProcsSharedExtensions
methods.description: Initializes function pointers for shared extensions.

methods.name: initProcsDesktopGLNULL
methods.description: Initializes null implementations for desktop GL if ANGLE_ENABLE_OPENGL_NULL is defined.

methods.name: initProcsGLESNULL
methods.description: Initializes null implementations for GLES if ANGLE_ENABLE_OPENGL_NULL is defined.

methods.name: initProcsSharedExtensionsNULL
methods.description: Initializes null implementations for shared extensions if ANGLE_ENABLE_OPENGL_NULL is defined.
